---
title: "Research"
---

My work sits at the intersection of soil microbial ecology, biogeochemical cycling, and long-term agricultural management. I use sequencing-based approaches and wet-lab methods to understand how microbial communities drive nitrogen transformations in soil.

## Methods I Use

**Molecular:** DNA/RNA extraction, 16S & nifH amplicon sequencing, metagenomics, metatranscriptomics, qPCR, functional gene cloning

**Statistical:** R (vegan, phyloseq, ALDEx2), PCoA, NMDS, RDA, PERMANOVA, differential abundance analysis

**Field:** Soil sampling, gas flux measurement, camera trap deployment, point count bird surveys, acoustic recording
